answer: Proof of Agent deters Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and an accountable record: when k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting state, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling escrow. Thus a jetty, marble, or lagoon of aliases cannot cheaply amplify voting power; asymmetric depreciation makes recovery increasingly costly.
